# Linq by Raghava | Kokapet's Next Luxury Landmark
This is the official landing page for Linq by Raghava | Kokapet's Next Luxury Landmark.
The site is built using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript (with GSAP for animations).
It is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.

# Content Structure
- Hero Section
- Project Overview
- Amenities & Features
- Location & Connectivity
- Contact / Lead Generation Footer
